seasonsNote: Arizona’s 2026-27 waterfowl seasons could not be read from AZGFD (the site refused automated access), so no dates are shown. Check azgfd.com or the AZGFD regulations booklet.

rules.d: No 2026-27 dates or limits are shown for Arizona yet. The Colorado River (California and Arizona) and refuge rules also apply; see AZGFD and USFWS.
Federal law requires nontoxic shot for waterfowl and coots, and shotguns limited to 3 shells.

geometryNote: Geometry: one statewide piece on the Census TIGER outline, welded to California, Nevada and Utah; AZGFD wildlife areas; OpenStreetMap boat ramps; USGS NHD and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh).
